evals.prompt: I need to add user authentication to my Node/Express backend. How should I start?
evals.expected_output: The response should calibrate explanations for a junior developer, infer the stack or domain implicitly, avoid asking to create persona files, explain JWT vs Session authentication, provide middleware code skeletons (no complete solutions), and include a Conceptual Insight and a Next Step Exercise.

assertions.name: no_persona_prompt
assertions.description: The response does not ask the user to create a PERSONA.md or .mentor.md file.

assertions.name: has_conceptual_insight
assertions.description: The response contains the '## Conceptual Insight' section header.

assertions.name: has_next_step_exercise
assertions.description: The response contains the '## Next Step Exercise' section header.

assertions.name: contains_middleware_example
assertions.description: The response provides a code block showing an Express middleware or route handler skeleton.

evals.prompt: My React component state updates are behaving weirdly: the state value is always one step behind when I log it right after calling setState. What is happening and how do I fix it?
evals.expected_output: The response should explain React state batching and asynchronous updates to a junior developer, show how to use functional updates or useEffect/callbacks, avoid asking to create persona files, and include a Conceptual Insight and a Next Step Exercise.

assertions.name: no_persona_prompt
assertions.description: The response does not ask the user to create a PERSONA.md or .mentor.md file.

assertions.name: has_conceptual_insight
assertions.description: The response contains the '## Conceptual Insight' section header.

assertions.name: has_next_step_exercise
assertions.description: The response contains the '## Next Step Exercise' section header.

assertions.name: explains_state_asynchrony
assertions.description: The response explains why the state is not updated immediately (e.g. async/batching).
